channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Após vazamento, diretor do INSS anuncia fim de grupo de campanha para Lula
item.description: The director of Benefits and Relations at INSS, Leonardo Bittencourt, announced the termination of the WhatsApp group 'INSS with Lula', created by public employees to support Lula’s campaign, after its exposure by the press. He stated the group used only private phones, had no institutional ties, and that no retaliation would occur against non-participants. The group had been used to organize a pro-Lula event and distribute campaign shirts, despite electoral law prohibiting public campaigning before August 16.

item.title: Rejeição de Flávio acende alerta em campanha de Tarcísio, que fala em ‘limite’ para apoio
item.description: The high rejection of Flávio Bolsonaro and ongoing crises involving his campaign have raised concerns in Tarcísio de Freitas’ team, which is maintaining active distance from supporting the senator to avoid risks to his own re-election in São Paulo. Despite the nominal alliance, Tarcísio prioritizes his own governance legacy and proposals, rejecting any association that could transfer Flávio’s rejection to his image. The PT, led by Fernando Haddad, seeks to exploit this linkage to attach Bolsonaro’s rejection to the governor, while polls show 47% of São Paulo voters prefer an independent governor, and the election may be decided in the first round between Tarcísio and Haddad.

item.title: Maior colégio eleitoral do país, SP atrai convenções partidárias de principais pré-candidatos à presidência
item.description: Four of the five main presidential pre-candidates for 2026 will officially launch their candidacies in conventions held in São Paulo between July 25 and August 5. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will be launched on July 25 at Arena Pacaembu, followed by Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) on July 26 at the party headquarters. Renan Santos (Missão) will unveil his candidacy at the party’s first congress in Mooca, while Lula (PT) is also expected to finalize his ticket in São Paulo, although the text does not provide full details about his event.

item.title: Podcast discute como e por que Flávio Bolsonaro traz tarifaço de Trump para a eleição
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) traveled to the United States to participate in a hearing by the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) regarding the threat of new American tariffs against Brazil. His appearance aims to mitigate damages to his 2026 presidential pre-campaign, leveraging trade policy as a strategic talking point.

item.title: Tarifaço: governo Lula mandou dois diplomatas para audiência nos EUA
item.description: The Lula government sent two diplomats from the Brazilian embassy in Washington to observe the USTR hearing on a proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian imports. The diplomats, economic minister-counselor Kassius Pontes and a junior secretary, took notes for Brasília without speaking. The hearing gained attention due to the participation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who spoke against the tariff, while the government chose to negotiate through the bilateral working group established during the Lula-Trump meeting at the White House in May 2026.

item.title: Audiência sobre tarifaço: tom técnico gera otimismo a participantes
item.description: Brazilian business associations and company representatives expressed optimism following the USTR hearing on the proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, citing the technical nature of the discussions and focus on mutual economic impacts. They believed they successfully conveyed that the measure would harm not only Brazil but also U.S. businesses and consumers, in contrast to the more politicized 2025 hearing.

item.title: Bancadas na Câmara travam votação de projeto que criminaliza misoginia
item.description: The bill criminalizing misoginia is facing resistance in the Chamber of Deputies, particularly from evangelical and Catholic caucuses and parties like PL and Novo, which argue for more debate and fear restrictions on religious freedom and expression. Despite this, the government base, led by the PT and supported by rapporteur Tabata Amaral (PSB-SP), is pushing to pass the bill before the parliamentary recess on July 18, with Chamber President Hugo Motta maintaining a working group to seek consensus.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro implora a Trump: tarifaço, agora não
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro appealed to Trump in Washington to block a new tariff on Brazilian exports, arguing that imposing it now would harm his 2026 presidential campaign by benefiting Lula politically. He reversed his earlier stance, changing from 'postponement' to 'cancellation' after backlash, and claimed the 2025 tariff boosted Lula’s poll numbers. Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro now hope Trump will temporarily suspend the measure to avoid electoral damage.

item.title: Lindbergh pede investigação sobre elo entre Dark Horse e PCC
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) asked the Supreme Court to investigate the link between Entre Investimentos — which funded the 'Dark Horse' film about Jair Bolsonaro — and ACX ITC Tecnologia, a firm tied to the PCC used for money laundering, after Operation Saturno identified a R$26 million transfer. He also requested that Coaf, the Central Bank, the Federal Revenue, and the PF gather financial data from involved entities, including Banco Master, Daniel Vorcaro, and Eduardo Bolsonaro’s allies, to attach to Operation Compliance Zero.

item.title: Candidatura de Cunha em MG é "problemaço", diz irmão de Cleitinho
item.description: Eduardo Azevedo (PL), brother of Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos), labeled Eduardo Cunha's (Republicanos) pre-candidacy for federal deputy in Minas Gerais as a 'big problem' due to Cunha's corruption and money laundering convictions from Operation Car Wash. Although one conviction was annulled by the STF in 2023, Cleitinho's allies fear Cunha's tainted reputation could harm the Republican ticket in the state, where Cleitinho is running for governor. Cunha previously ran in São Paulo in 2022 and served four terms in Rio de Janeiro before seeking a return to Congress via Minas Gerais.

item.title: "Ele quer", diz irmão de Cleitinho sobre candidatura ao governo de MG
item.description: Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) wants to run for governor of Minas Gerais in 2026, according to his brother, state deputy Eduardo Azevedo (PL), who said the decision has already been made internally but depends on party negotiations. The PL in Minas Gerais, with its convention set for July 25, is pressuring for a swift announcement amid internal disagreements over supporting Cleitinho due to controversies involving Flávio Bolsonaro and the 'Dark Horse' film. While some in the PL advocate an alternative candidacy led by Vittorio Medioli, Cleitinho continues campaigning without an official declaration.

item.title: Campanha de Lula abandona IA por ordem do presidente
item.description: Lula’s campaign has decided to avoid using artificial intelligence in producing social media content and electoral materials, following a direct order from the president, who is critical of the technology and concerned about legal risks. The move also aims to prevent issues with the Electoral Justice, aligning with new TSE rules that restrict AI use in the 72 hours before and 24 hours after voting. Lula previously stated that citizens with ethical formation should not rely on AI for campaigns, as it can favor lies.

item.title: Ministro de Lula ganha aval para integrar conselho de estatal no Ceará
item.description: Education Minister Leonardo Barchini received approval from the Public Ethics Commission to join the fiscal council of Cagece while remaining in office, provided he adheres to restrictions such as not using privileged information or representing the company before the MEC. The rapporteur determined there is no conflict of interest, as his duties at the sanitation company are not directly related to the MEC's responsibilities.

item.title: Os acenos dos emissários de Lula ao mercado
item.description: Lula is leveraging missteps in Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign and the World Cup window to improve his image among financial markets, which have long rejected the PT leader. The strategy emphasizes fiscal responsibility and dialogue with productive sectors, aiming to overcome one of his core electoral weaknesses as an incumbent.

item.title: Ouvidorias fortalecem diálogo entre Justiça Eleitoral e sociedade, afirma presidente do TSE
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, president of the TSE, emphasized that the Electoral Justice's ombudsmen are pillars for strengthening democracy, acting as permanent channels of dialogue with society and transforming citizen demands into improvements in public services. He stressed that listening to the population in a qualified manner is essential to increase trust in democratic institutions and reaffirmed the Electoral Justice's commitment to placing the citizen at the center of its actions.

item.title: TSE lança ferramenta para análise da participação do eleitorado brasileiro no exterior
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) launched the Electoral Panel for Overseas Voters, a tool that consolidates historical microdata on the profile, geographic distribution, and participation of Brazilians eligible to vote abroad. The platform aims to support electoral logistics planning and improve public access to data previously requiring complex spreadsheets, focusing on turnout and abstention rates across global polling stations. The 2026 electoral roll data will be released by the end of July.

item.title: TSE lança nova versão da ferramenta de pesquisa de jurisprudência eleitoral
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) launched an improved version of its electoral jurisprudence research tool, featuring a more intuitive interface, multi-device responsiveness, and faster, more accurate results. The update aims to enhance accessibility and efficiency for lawyers, researchers, judges, and the public, reinforcing the TSE’s commitment to digital modernization and access to electoral legal knowledge.

item.title: Infraestrutura de Tecnologia da Informação do TSE passa por atualização na segunda-feira (6)
item.description: The TSE will carry out IT infrastructure updates from next Monday (6) to Friday (10) to maintain the Candidacy System database for the 2026 elections candidate registration, which begins on July 20. During this period, the Candidaturas, Cand2, Bem na Foto, DivulgaCandContas, and CANDex Web systems will be unavailable, preventing judgment updates and reprocessing of election tallies for which ARCs have not yet been received by Sistot.

item.title: Defeso eleitoral impõe limites a agentes públicos a três meses das Eleições 2026
item.description: Starting August 4, the electoral blackout period begins, prohibiting public officials from conducting institutional publicity, personnel actions, and fund transfers until October 25 to ensure equal opportunities among candidates in the 2026 General Elections. The rules apply to federal and state public servants, direct and indirect, under Law No. 9,504/1997 and TSE Resolution No. 23,735/2024.

item.title: Clica e Confirma destaca balanço do 1º semestre no TSE e início do período de condutas vedadas
item.description: The Clica e Confirma program highlighted the TSE’s first-half 2026 performance, with 88 judgment sessions and 1,656 cases ruled on, alongside the start of the prohibited conduct period on July 4, imposing restrictions on public officials and pre-candidates to ensure electoral equality. The episode also covered a technical alignment meeting between TSE and regional electoral courts (TREs) to strengthen election security and urn functionality.

item.title: TSE realiza audiência técnica sobre divulgação de resultados das Eleições 2026
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will hold a virtual technical hearing on Monday (6) at 3 p.m. to align procedures with media outlets and institutions interested in disseminating the official results of the 2026 General Elections. The meeting will cover the official results distribution model, technological standards adopted by the TSE, information security requirements, and technical guidelines for accessing Electoral Justice services, aiming to ensure transparency and standardization in result dissemination.

item.title: À espera do tarifaço: as consequências econômicas para Brasil e EUA - O Assunto #1756
item.description: The U.S. Trade Office held public hearings on proposed tariffs against Brazilian exports, featuring input from multinational corporations and pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, who called for cancellation of the measure. Economist Daniel Sousa analyzed the economic consequences, emphasizing Brazil's role in global supply chains and the potential impact on U.S. inflation. A final decision is expected by July 15.

item.title: Tarifaço: Caiado diz que Flávio "conspirou" contra economia do Brasil
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) of 'conspiring against Brazil's economy' for his role in discussions regarding the 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian goods, calling his actions unacceptable and ideologically driven. Caiado also criticized the Itamaraty for abandoning technical diplomacy in favor of ideological foreign policy, claiming it harmed diplomatic relations with the United States.

item.title: Lula reúne aliados para debater ações de campanha, e PT espera definição sobre Minas
item.description: Lula met with allies at the Palácio da Alvorada to assess the pre-campaign and discuss next steps following the start of the electoral blackout period. The meeting covered digital efforts, campaign segments, and the definition of state-level electoral slates, focusing on Minas Gerais and Goiás. The PT aims to finalize candidates within ten days due to the proximity of party conventions, with Minas Gerais being the main challenge given its electoral weight and uncertainty after Rodrigo Pacheco’s withdrawal and Marília Campos’ public rejection of the Senate candidacy.

item.title: Lula e Flávio testam argumentos sobre tarifaço em prévia de embate da campanha eleitoral
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro exchanged accusations over the U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, with the government alleging the senator acted for electoral gain and even treason, while Flávio argued the timing is harmful and accused the government of politicizing the issue. The Secom labeled Flávio's participation in the USTR hearing as opportunistic and linked him to the 'Tariflávio' narrative.

item.title: Participação de coordenador da campanha de Flávio em evento com Marco Rubio e Joesley gera incômodo em ala da campanha
item.description: Vicente Santini, a coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign, attended an event in Washington with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and businessman Joesley Batista without informing key campaign allies, causing discomfort among Eduardo Bolsonaro's supporters. The event took place at The Executive Branch, a private club linked to Donald Trump Jr., and raised concerns about conflicts of interest, as Santini also represents J&F Group companies, whose owners are viewed as adversaries of Bolsonarism by some allies.

item.title: Após audiência, Flávio faz rodada de reuniões em Washington para tentar reforçar ofensiva contra tarifaço
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) postponed his schedule in Pernambuco to remain in Washington and hold private meetings with USTR officials and Trump administration representatives, aiming to overturn the proposed 25% additional tariff on Brazilian products, with a final decision expected July 15. He seeks to reinforce the technical and political arguments made during the USTR public hearing, viewing his participation as positive and seeking to influence the outcome of the trade investigation before its conclusion.

item.title: Crédito para o agro: veja o que o governo cogita para aliviar dívidas do setor e contornar bomba fiscal
item.description: The Lula government is preparing measures to reduce rural producers' debt, aiming to bring agribusiness closer to the government ahead of the 2026 elections. These initiatives follow recent programs targeting self-employed workers and seek to overcome sector resistance to the PT, avoiding a fiscal time bomb. The content is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Tarifaço: Flávio Bolsonaro não trata de etanol e de desmatamento em audiência, alvos de crítica dos EUA
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) participated in a USTR public hearing on proposed tariffs against Brazilian goods, focusing his remarks on social media regulation, corruption, and defense of the PIX payment system. He omitted mention of deforestation, ethanol market access, and intellectual property — issues cited in the USTR’s Section 301 report as justification for a proposed 25% tariff. Bolsonaro criticized President Lula and the Supreme Court, arguing the timing is the 'worst possible' for such measures and urging delay until after Brazil’s 2026 elections.

item.title: Múcio tem agenda com auxiliar de Trump após EUA classificarem facções como terroristas
item.description: Defense Minister José Múcio Monteiro will meet with U.S. Undersecretary of War Elbridge A. Colby at the Defense Ministers Conference of the Americas in Peru, following the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, which the Brazilian government opposed. The meeting aims to ease tensions between Brazil and the U.S., seeking to build a peaceful security cooperation framework with regional support, despite concerns from the Itamaraty about potential U.S. interference in Brazil’s internal security affairs.

item.title: Receita de GO com consignado mais que dobrou após lei sugerida em reunião com o Master
item.description: The Goiás state government's revenue from payroll-deductible credit increased by approximately 150% between 2023 and 2025 during the administration of Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), a pre-candidate for president. This growth followed the approval of a state executive-proposed law, resulting from a meeting with a director of Banco Master.

item.title: Flávio não atacou as tarifas. Palavras fazem sentido. Ele as defendeu
item.description: The text refutes the claim that Flávio Bolsonaro attacked U.S. tariffs on Brazil, stating instead that he defended a posture of tolerance and appeasement, avoiding any direct contestation of American measures. Flávio endorsed narratives minimizing corruption in Brazil, despite allies being investigated by the PF, and used his USTR appearance to protect his personal and political interests, not to defend the country. The author concludes that Flávio seeks a 'better moment' for tariffs — meaning he accepts their eventual application, as long as it doesn’t happen now — revealing a stance of submission to the U.S.

item.title: Dark Horse: filme sobre Bolsonaro recebe registro da Ancine
item.description: Distributor Europa Filmes has filed the Foreign Work Registration (ROE) request with Ancine for the controversial biopic 'Dark Horse', depicting Jair Bolsonaro's 2018 presidential campaign. The film, starring Jim Caviezel as Bolsonaro, has completed the first administrative step required for commercial exhibition in Brazilian cinemas. The distributor stated it will proceed with regulatory, commercial, and operational steps to set a release date, to be announced upon completion.

item.title: Zema cita empresário Geraldo Rufino como possível nome à vaga de vice
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party’s pre-candidate for president in 2026, stated that businessman Geraldo Rufino, founder of JR Diesel and a native of Minas Gerais, is being considered as a potential running mate. Zema noted they have had multiple conversations since his time as governor and that Rufino has expressed willingness to join the ticket. The final decision rests with the party, which is also in talks with other parties lacking presidential candidates to form a clean slate.

item.title: Lula paga recorde de emendas antes da eleição, mas prevê ampliar críticas na campanha
item.description: President Lula disbursed a record volume of parliamentary amendments shortly before the 2026 election, yielding to congressional pressure. Nevertheless, he intends to intensify criticism of the use of these funds during the campaign and include in his government program a proposal to revise the amendment model, aiming to reduce legislative influence over the budget.

item.title: Flávio diz que EUA derrubou “mentira petista” sobre intervenção no Brasil
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) claimed the U.S. government debunked the Lula administration’s fears of U.S. military intervention in Brazil, accusing the Itamaraty of spreading 'petista' misinformation. He called it 'absurd' that Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira feared the designation of PCC and CV as terrorist groups could justify U.S. military action, arguing it only threatens criminals. The U.S. State Department’s response, reported by Metrópoles, stated the U.S. is acting within its sovereign authority to combat narcoterrorist gangs operating in the U.S.

item.title: Paulo Vieira, amigo de Lula a Luciano Huck, resgata espaço do humor na Globo
item.description: The series Pablo & Luisão, created by Paulo Vieira and inspired by his childhood in Palmas (TO), returns to TV Globo in traditional comedy time slots, marking the network's return to humor on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Vieira, a friend of Luciano Huck and close to President Lula and Janja, also gained attention in 2026 for winning a lawsuit against Luciano Hang, a Bolsonaro supporter.

item.title: “Desmentido por instituição estrangeira séria”, diz Flávio sobre Lula
item.description: Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated that the U.S. Department of State denied the hypothesis raised by Itamaraty regarding a possible American military action after the U.S. classified CV and PCC as terrorist organizations. He described the foreign institution as 'serious,' implicitly contrasting it with the Lula government and suggesting the U.S. is correcting a mistaken Brazilian narrative.

item.title: A resposta dos EUA à avaliação do Itamaraty sobre risco de operações militares no Brasil
item.description: The United States dismissed as absurd the Itamaraty assessment that it might conduct military operations in Brazil after designating the Comando Vermelho and Primeiro Comando da Capital as terrorist organizations. The State Department said U.S. actions are based on sovereign prerogatives to combat narcoterrorists now operating in the U.S. The Itamaraty assessment appears in responses to information requests by federal deputies, signed by Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira.

item.title: Preso com fuzil, Canella deu aula de segurança pública em MBA em maio
item.description: Belford Roxo's former mayor and União Brasil Senate pré-candidate, Márcio Canella, was arrested after Federal Police found a rifle in his car during Operation Unha e Carne. Despite the arrest, he had been highlighted in May as a speaker at the launch of a Public Security MBA, where he was presented as a model in fighting organized crime. The PF alleges his group moved over R$ 7.6 billion in six years, using fuel companies for money laundering and involving public agents.

item.title: Falas de Flávio Bolsonaro podem enfraquecer argumento brasileiro contra o tarifaço
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro attended a U.S. hearing to oppose proposed tariffs on Brazilian goods, arguing the measure would politically benefit President Lula ahead of Brazil’s 2026 elections. According to VEJA columnist Diogo Schelp, while Bolsonaro aimed to counteract the political damage from his family’s association with the 'tariff barrage,' his remarks on the Supreme Court and anti-corruption efforts reinforced U.S. justifications for the trade investigation, weakening Brazil’s defense. Only his defense of the PIX payment system was seen as a substantively effective argument for Brazilian interests.

item.title: Caiado diz que aceita propor ampliação do crime de traição à pátria no Brasil em meio ao tarifaço
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) said he would support a bill to criminalize treason in the ordinary Penal Code, currently only applicable in wartime under the Military Penal Code. He made the statement during a sabatina by the nonpartisan group Derrubando Muros, after learning that treason is not a crime in the common Penal Code. Caiado also opposed Flávio Bolsonaro’s proposal to delay U.S. tariffs until after the election, stating he is against any postponement serving electoral interests.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz nos EUA que taxas beneficiariam Lula em reunião sobre tarifas
item.description: Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) urged the United States to delay imposing 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, arguing it would politically benefit President Lula. He stated that with presidential elections in October, imposing tariffs now would be inappropriate and could reward the current administration. Instead, he proposed targeted individual sanctions if the U.S. seeks to pressure Brazilian authorities.

item.title: PGR pede ao STF que valide decretos de Lula que elevaram o IOF
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet urged the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to uphold President Lula’s decrees raising the IOF, stating the measures adhered to constitutional limits and were grounded in regulatory justifications, not merely fiscal ones. He argued Congress lacked authority to suspend the decrees, as the Executive did not overstep its tax regulatory power, and that fiscal motive alone does not constitute abuse of power.

item.title: Senado aprova projeto que endurece penas para violência sexual digital contra menores
item.description: The Senate symbolically approved a bill increasing penalties for digital sexual violence against minors, including offenses involving AI, deepfakes, fake profiles, and IP masking. The law raises penalties for luring minors under 14, classifies these crimes as heinous, establishes new preventive detention grounds, authorizes 'virtual rounds' by investigators without prior judicial approval, and mandates psychological care for victims funded by perpetrators. The bill now awaits President Lula's sanction.

item.title: O que é o Pix Pensão, projeto aprovado no Congresso que vai para sanção de Lula
item.description: The 'Pix Pension' bill, approved by Congress, establishes automatic monthly child support payments via Pix, deducting funds directly from the debtor's account without manual transfer, even without formal employment. Authored by federal deputy Tabata Amaral and reported by Senator Ana Paula Lobato, the measure aims to reduce bureaucracy, ensure judicial rulings are enforced, and protect thousands of families, especially children. It now awaits presidential sanction by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Nikolas nega ter ajudado Michelle em vídeo contra Flávio
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) denied having helped Michelle Bolsonaro produce the video in which she criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, stating that neither he nor his team participated in the video’s conception, scripting, production, or editing. He pledged to resign if anyone proves his involvement, responding to claims made by GloboNews journalist Andreia Sadi.

item.title: Zema diz que Geraldo Rufino está entre os cotados para vice
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) stated that Geraldo Rufino (Podemos) is among the candidates being considered for his vice-presidential ticket in the 2026 elections, with a decision expected within two weeks. Zema also advocated for a public spending reduction agenda, including privatizations, pension reform, and social program reviews, to lower interest rates and improve fiscal sustainability.

item.title: Em audiência nos EUA, Flávio Bolsonaro acusa governo Lula e pede suspensão de tarifas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) attended a public hearing in Washington to challenge the 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian goods, accusing the Lula administration of harming American companies and proposing economic concessions to suspend the measure.

item.title: PF apreende R$ 800 mil com alvo de operação que mira ex-prefeito e ex-chefe da Polícia do Rio
item.description: The Federal Police seized R$800,000 in cash during the sixth phase of Operation Unha e Carne, which investiges a suspected R$7.6 billion money laundering scheme involving former Belford Roxo mayor Márcio Canella (União Brasil) and former Rio de Janeiro police chief Marcus Amin. Canella, a Senate pre-candidate, was arrested in flagrante for illegal possession of a .556 caliber assault rifle and had his assets frozen by court order.
